title: No feature-source bypass
rule: All feature construction must request observations through the PIT gateway/as-of interface.

title: Knowledge cutoff
rule: Observation first_known_at/policy-derived knowledge time must not exceed feature cutoff.

title: Target validity
rule: Observation must be valid/applicable for the target event/state time where the domain requires validity intervals.

title: Revision replay
rule: A revision/correction first known after the cutoff cannot replace the version that was knowable at the cutoff.

title: Unknown timing fails closed
rule: Missing/ambiguous temporal evidence cannot be guessed into PIT eligibility.

title: Retrospective evidence
rule: Retrospective/current pages require dated corroboration before historical use.

title: Historical game completion
rule: Same-game/future-game outcomes cannot enter pregame features; prior-game outputs require completion before cutoff.

title: Market lane isolation
rule: Market evidence is excluded from pure-football lane and is timestamp-gated in market-augmented lane.

title: Weather run lineage
rule: Issued weather feature requires exact model/run availability and target-valid time; observed truth cannot replace earlier forecast.

title: Availability noncoverage
rule: No official report outside policy scope is UNKNOWN, never affirmative availability.

title: Cutoff immutability
rule: Forecast/training cutoff objects and policy version are immutable lineage records.

title: Training chronology
rule: Historical training replay may use labels only from games completed/known before that model-training cutoff; each example feature row still uses its own pregame cutoff.
